tasks.title: Integrate managed worker rescan immutable build provenance and drain compatibility
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver the concrete Management-backed run source and bounded worker ready-run rescan using the existing managed bootstrap/control/reconciliation and Jobs owners. Each actual local immutable handler/startup build/contract binding is checked before selecting/entering work and copied to durable attempts; payload/desire labels do not supply authority or build identity. Missing compatible workers retain same pending/unknown run with bounded NoCompatibleWorkerVersion and no business retry consumed. Close new runs/retries/acquisitions/continuous iterations during local drain or Management outage, retain entered finite code/renewal/settlement dependencies, and join actual callback/scope lifetime. Reconnect/restart rescan authoritative responsibility; no lost local prompt or new independent execution fleet/lease/retry engine. Owns worker/lifecycle slices of RM10-AC01, RM10-AC14, RM10-AC17, RM10-AC18, RM10-AC19, RM10-AC20, RM10-AC29, RM10-AC32, RM10-AC36, RM10-AC37, RM10-AC38, RM10-AC39, RM10-AC40.
tasks.validation: Reuse existing actual native Management/Jobs/Coordination fixtures for closed-bootstrap/admission and current build/identity/contract selection, bounded rescan/reconnect, old-build finite drain and continuous next-iteration refusal. Test missing compatibility and unsupported rollback without changing ownership key or captured run. Keep original-outcome interrupted effect proof with delivery integration; document deployment/drain limits and review independently. Verify this owner consumes only the declared medium prerequisites (WORK-161, WORK-158, WORK-160) and keeps the original parent accounting pool; broad provenance containers are not early completion prerequisites.
